title: Citus: sharded topology (Shards populated — distributed-table placements per worker group)
description: Runs `nexus topology citus`. Populates the Shards table: one row per worker group with its Patroni primary + replica and the count of `events` shards placed on it (16 + 16 of 32), the distributed-sharding showcase.

observe.what: Nodes table (group/role per node) + Shards table: worker1 (primary worker1-2, replica worker1-1, 16 events shards) + worker2 (primary worker2-1, replica worker2-2, 16 shards)
JSON TopologySnapshot with shards[] non-null (2 TopologyShard — one per worker group) — the genuinely-sharded showcase

whatProves: CitusAdapter.TopologyAsync emits a populated Shards array (one TopologyShard per worker group, with its Patroni primary/replica + its citus_shards count of the events table), distinguishing Citus distribution from non-sharded HA clusters.
